# Executed connection from anchor intervals to monitored reuse

29 October 2026, Australia/Brisbane. This composes frozen inputs; it is not
another bath fit, dynamics solver or measurement campaign.

`compile_anchor_reuse.py` reads the exact declared parameter-box receipt
from `../physical/anchored_contact_certificate.json` and the exact
coefficients from `reusable_memory_certificate.json`. It pins the input
proofs/receipts and preserves their data status. Its output is
`anchor_reuse_composition.json`.

Both cases use vhat=2, thetahat=pi/2, nhat=1/20000; the same known
nonnegative normalized passive shape; source action <=1/100 per contact;
v<=21/10, n<=1/10000; and the region <N_a><=1/1600. All inverse radii
are charged. The cold thermal contribution is the exact supremum of
|n-nhat|/[(1+n)(1+nhat)] at the interval endpoints.

| Declared mean radius | 1,000-contact raw allowance | Capped distance | Hypothetical native-a vacuum starts |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1/80 | 2.248163400582621 | 1 | 245,643 |
| 1e-7 | 0.000860955999042012 | 0.000860955999042012 | 3,838,157,793,129,690 |

All displays round upward. These are complete retained a/source/reference/
record distances, extendable through common causal collectors and detectors
under `DETECTOR_CLOSED_REUSE.md`. The initial computation state must
separately be identified in the region, or use the main preparation
comparison. The occupied post-calibration state is not a free new start.
Data-selected initialization must obey its input contract; an unconditional
mean alone is not a normalized rare-branch cap.

The moderate example fails to certify 1,000 contacts usefully. This is
failure of a sufficient certificate, not a device limitation. The narrow
example proves the interval-to-operation bridge, but ordinary visibility
acquisition is extremely costly: the plan would use 6,396,929,655,216,150
controlled-Weyl calls and 2,558,771,862,086,460 fresh thermal calibration
inputs/passive transits. None were consumed. These are sufficient
fixed-design Hoeffding budgets under the supplied trusted experiment,
not sampling lower bounds, measured runtimes or guarantees of favorable
realized centers.

Neither case has acquired counts. A private analytic fixture generated
DECLARED mean boxes. The compiler attaches NO confidence coverage to them.
If future independent complete episodes yield valid simultaneous confidence
boxes

statement: For the supplied anchor inputs, the moderate mean radius 1/80 caps the 1000-contact bound at one. The declared 1e-7 radius gives an upper below .000860956 but requires 3838157793129690 hypothetical vacuum starts under the stated fixed-design visibility plan. The interval compiler attaches no confidence to the analytic fixture boxes.
